text: answer[math-c5678901-open]: Applying the extended Euclidean algorithm gives 1 = 2055·554167 − 234131·4864. Therefore, the coefficient of 4864 is −234131 modulo 554167. Converting to the required positive representative gives x = 554167 − 234131 = 320036. Verification: 4864·320036 = 2809·554167 + 1, so the modular inverse is 320036.
